## Plugin reference

- Description: Side chat: an icon split under the prompt that opens a new, blank conversation in the same worktree — the icon on the default model, the chevron to pick another.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Conversation.PromptBar` "New" → `ForkConversationButtons`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-view.Conversation`
    - `primitives/launch.LaunchControl`
